        - heading "3. UNDERSTAND THE RULE" [level=3]
        - paragraph: A graph is bipartite if and only if it has no odd cycle. Equivalently, the vertices can be colored with two colors so that every edge joins vertices of different colors.
        - text: Definition (Bipartite Graph)
        - paragraph: A graph G = (V,E) is bipartite if V can be partitioned into two disjoint sets (A,B) such that every edge has one endpoint in A and the other in B.
